summary: Palladyne AI just won U.S. Army contracts (June 17-23) for SwarmOS autonomous swarm software + Gremlin-X mini-bomber UAV under the Army's Competitive Disruptive Applications program. SwarmOS lets 1 operator command an entire heterogeneous drone fleet simultaneously — the AI command layer every defense force needs. Market cap is only $280M vs an autonomous drone market projected at $50B+. The Northern Strike 26-2 exercise (9,000+ participants) is the next live-fire validation catalyst. Northland set a $15 target (138% upside) in June. Moon case: multi-branch DoD adoption = $30+ (375%).
